notes.title: Death Race, 8 New Environments, & Full Gamepad Support
notes.content:
[h2]8 New Environmental Modifiers[/h2][p]Each environment provides a gameplay modifier that grants special bonuses and impacts your vehicle in various ways. As you progress through gameplay milestones, environments shift at random and demand adaptation of playstyles in order to survive. [/p][h2][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45272033/e532420167839d7b5e01fe844b3a27b823658898.gif"][/img][/h2][p][b]Day:[/b] The starting point for all playthroughs, it provides a safe environment with increased visibility.[/p][p][b]Night: [/b]Weapons don't overheat during the cool desert nights so you can flex your arsenal without pausing to cool down.[/p][p][b]Dawn: [/b]The dawn of a new day brings new hope for survival. Your vehicle passively regenerates HP over time.[/p][p][b]Dusk: [/b]As the sun sets and engines cool, gain a massive increase to your vehicle's speed. [/p][p][b]Nitrogenic: [/b]Vividly-blue nitrogen skies provide an infinite supply of nitrous oxide for infinite boosting. [/p][p][b]Swamp: [/b]The air is saturated with a putrid moisture that decreases visibility and increases lightning damage.[/p][p][b]Blood Moon: [/b]A dark red ambience surrounds you, greatly reducing visibility in exchange for increased self-healing via leech/vampiric augments.[/p][p][b]Sulfuric: [/b]Sulfuric fog is harvested by your vehicle and provides an infinite supply of energy to be used by your active and passive abilities[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45272033/a0d50a9749960d6d9d66f77e97fe4a5b301cd0c9.png"][/img][/p][h3]Next update: procedural weather systems[/h3][p]To continue to shake things up, we'll be announcing a new weather system with sandstorms, thunderstorms, snowstorms, blood mist, and sinister fog.  [/p][p]Unlike environmental bonus modifiers, these weather effects are detrimental to your vehicle and only those who can adapt will survive.[/p][p][/p][h2]Roguelite Loop & Death Race[/h2][p]In-game race events. Win by outrunning or outgunning your opponents.[/p][previewyoutube="jxe2ByWPrtg;full"][/previewyoutube][h2]Gamepad Support[/h2][p]We've completed gamepad support and are now focusing on Steam Deck and console playability. More gamepad features and custom bindings to come.
[/p][h2]Kickstarter[/h2][p]Grab a discounted copy of the game and some limited edition rewards from Kickstarter. Campaign runs from Sep.1 through Sep. 30 2025.   [url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/madmetal/mad-metal"]Kickstarter[/url] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45272033/75f7f5ff8c5e0ade2636cd9d7187ba3e2321ba0e.png"][/img][/p][p]Back us on [url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/madmetal/mad-metal"]Kickstarter [/url] to receive the game and merch at a deeply reduced cost relative to post-launch pricing. [/p][p][url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/madmetal/mad-metal"]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/madmetal/mad-metal[/url]

Keep it metal 🤘   [/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Major Demo Overhaul
notes.content:

700 playtests + 6,000 demo plays = one big patch.

[h2][b]Arena Mode & Infinite Open-World[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Players can now choose between arena-style deathmatches based on real-world locations, or explore an infinite open-world wasteland.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45272033/1417fb62cda8d01f6ab8acc6017c2f99a69a128c.png[/img]

[h2][b]New Vehicles:[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45272033/bc2620305938ad5600f35c551dd565560e78d442.png[/img]
[list]
[*]Falcon (based loosely on the 2015 Dodge Challenger SRT Hellcat).
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45272033/cd778e755b995e965ec8d171d60f1c4c6ee7c939.png[/img]
[list]

[list]
[*] The main menu was removed in favor of an in-game menu. This change has been reverted and players now start in the main menu.
[*] Added autodetection of screen resolution.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45272033/ae36dc04cd6b95e37db0e99860a1c88ace4c4a18.png[/img]

[h2][b]Camera Switching[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Added a third FPS-style camera for the primary weapon.

[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45272033/9a9121215b848b489b857d071b20c8413ee7ebfe.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]Graphics Overhaul[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Next-gen lighting & ray marching for high end graphics cards.
[*] Added 4 graphics presets to choose from.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45272033/43bddf96fab7ce691b974e6148abbb69dd3a394e.png[/img]

[h2]On-The-Fly Vehicle Adjustments[/h2]
[list]
[*] Activate the ancient garage for in-game vehicle modification without having to go to the main menu.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45272033/382261bd4dede838873f4148bafeb77003da66c8.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]Hundreds of Bug Fixes and Performance Optimizations[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed all known camera rotation and camera switching issues.
[*] Fixed all known crashes on level start.
[*] Fixed 100% GPU usage in main menu.
[*] Fixed underutilized multithreaded CPU usage.
[/list]

Stay tuned for a Kickstarter announcement (with limited edition rewards like diecast vehicle models). Also in the works is an original soundtrack and campaign/story mode reveal!

Thank you all for your support.
Stay Metal 🤘

notes.title: Mad Metal Demo Launched!
notes.content:
The Mad Metal Demo is finally here!

[previewyoutube=Ri7hRfaHdMc;full][/previewyoutube]

New vehicles
- Buggy: light class with jetpacks
- Vigilante: heavy class with grapple
- Phoenix: medium class flame arson
- Pipe Dreamer: medium class 360-degree artillery gunner

New components:
- Pipe Dreamer's Kit: a full-body heavy armor kits
- Horned Basher: front-guard with great reach

Augment System:
- Choose from powerful augments that alter each playthrough
- Find hidden augments scattered around each map

Performance changes
- Adaptative DLSS
- FPS target raised from 60fps to 120fps

Balance updates:
- Increased avg damage, firerate, and health

New Demo progression system
- Designed to unlock everything within 30-40 minutes of playtime

Paint:
- Players can now change materials and apply paints to their vehicle.
- Temporarily removed painting of individual parts.

Minimap:
- Increased minimap size.
- Correctly displays real-world coordinates of the map.
- Player and Enemy icons are now displayed above other icons.
- Enemy icons correctly align with the corresponding vehicle's forward direction.

Tutorial:
- Players can now retry the distance score challenge.

New York City (level):
- Each enemy now has a unique weapon loadout.
- Environmental props have been reworked to prevent getting stuck under the vehicles and impeding their movement.
- Temporarily removed highly obstructive environmental props.
- Reduced memory requirements.

Grand Canyon (level):
- Removed some ground rock formations to prevent vehicles from getting stuck.

AI Enemies:
- AI is now better at avoiding obstacles.
- AI will no longer pursue or fire at targets when their line of sight is obstructed.

Time To Kill:
- TTK has been doubled for all vehicles (avg. HP increased from 100 to 200).
- Vehicles that previously had 2 primary weapons now have 1 primary weapon (this is to facilitate weapon rebalancing and prevent high-powered weapons from being abused on some vehicles).

Weapons:
- Added muzzle flash effects to all weapons.

Vulcan (Gatling):
- Fire rate increased from 15RPS to 50RPS.
- Audio changed to replicate a real gatling gun and to be less obtrusive with the new fire rate.

Solo Gun:
- Increased damage from 15 to 20.
- Increased projectile velocity from 200 to 300.
- Decreased size of impact and heat distortion effects by 50%.

Sniper:
- Increased damage from 25 to 45.
- Increased burnout rate from 25 to 55.

Shot Gun:
- Increased damage from 1x20 to 2x20.
- Decreased burnout rate from 30 to 26.

Seeker:
- Increased damage from 7.5 to 20.
- Increased burnout rate from 10 to 20.
- Decreased trail effects by 50%.

Rail Gun:
- Increased damage from 4 to 10.
- Increased firerate from 2RPS to 4RPS.
- Decreased burnout rate from 15 to 10.

Loading Screen:
- Added helpful information about hotkeys and weapon mechanics.

Bug:
- Fixed a bug that caused the vehicle to play unexpected crash sounds.
- Fixed a bug that prevented audio settings from affecting vehicle sounds.
- Fixed a bug that locked the third person camera.
- Fixed a bug that prevented the police vehicles from using their passive ability.

Various improvements, bug fixes, and lighting changes.

notes.title: Demo Release on May 9th, 2025 - End of Playtest on April 28th, 2025
notes.content:
We've been playtesting and responding to player feedback daily from March 28th to April 28th. Today marks the official end of the Mad Metal Playtest as we prepare to launch the demo in less than 2 weeks.

Thank you all for your contributions during the testing phase. We had a great turn up with an average of 20 daily playtesters, many of which provided incredibly valuable feedback.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45272033/303eb2c62e8cf440f3bc15db5821dfbbb7db6040.png[/img]

We will be releasing the [u][b]demo on May 9th, 2025[/b][/u].

The demo includes:
- 6 new vehicles + 6 new attachments, and 2 new characters!
- Another huge performance patch
- 40+ bug fixes 
- Extra settings options
- Reworked lighting, shadows, materials, and overall graphics quality
- Reworked progression system

I would love to see all the playtesters join us again for the demo release and to check out the massive improvements you've helped create.

See you on May 9th!

notes.title: Major Performance Overhaul - Alpha 0.31
notes.content:
[b]Performance across all devices has increased by an average of 50–60%[/b] when using DX12, and 25–50% when using DX11.

The target framerate has [b]doubled from 60 FPS to 120 FPS[/b].

[u][b]DX12 has been introduced for the following benefits:[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] [b]Split jobs (33% performance gain):[/b] Large objects normally rendered by the GPU are now split into smaller parts and distributed across all CPU cores. This significantly reduces GPU load and maximum CPU overhead.
[*] [b]Baked shadows and pre-rendered shaders (17% performance gain):[/b] Some static shadows are now pre-rendered to avoid real-time calculations. Shaders are also prebaked to reduce performance spikes. This significantly reduces GPU rendering load.
[*] [b]DLSS (10%-20% performance gain):[/b] On low- and mid-end devices, DLSS dynamically lowers the resolution and upscales it to your selected setting. This activates when framerate drops below 60 FPS, ensuring smooth gameplay regardless of scene complexity.
[*]  [b]Vegetation improvements, GPU occlusion culling, and burst jobs:[/b] General performance enhancements prevent rendering objects outside the player's view, combine similar objects into one draw call (e.g., 200 trees rendered as one object), and pre-process some rendering tasks before gameplay starts.
[/list]

Players who previously averaged 60 FPS should now expect around 120 FPS. Those who were below 60 FPS should now exceed 60 FPS, provided they meet the minimum recommended system requirements.

This is the first of three scheduled performance overhauls, and we will continue improving graphics settings and performance across all devices.
